notes.title: [update] optimize bone system and increase tickle mode
notes.notes:
·The skeleton system is optimized, and unnecessary skeleton operation is limited in story mode. Only when the skeleton is massaged, it will move slightly and truly.
·For example, tibia (lower leg) can only rotate in plane relative to thigh.
·Add independent tickling mode, and experience it quickly!
·Failed to solve the threading problem. Tried to add collision mechanism, but the effect is not good. For example, in reality, the skin is elastic, and the close fitting of legs is a natural action. But the collision body can't simulate the elasticity, adding collision mechanism can avoid wearing the mold, but it will limit many positions that can be achieved in reality. The above optimization is made after comprehensive consideration.
·"Story mode" is suitable for most players. There will be no more wearing models here. The hand feeling of massage has also been greatly improved.
·"Free mode" is suitable for deep players. You need to be patient to pose as you want. The hand feel of bone rotation is also optimized.
·In addition, if you have any suggestions, you can add developer friends or leave a message in the community. Thank you for your support.

notes.title: [bug fixed and update plan]
notes.notes:
·Due to the failure to do all-round test, some players have bugs in the process of the game, which brings us a bad experience. I sincerely apologize to you here.
·So far, we have fixed the bug that can't be cleared, and unlocked all contents, including clothing, story, posture. Hope the players have a good time.
·After receiving many suggestions from enthusiastic players, I plan to make the following update plans in these days:
1. Although the leg posture is free, it can pose a pose that is impossible in reality. We will optimize the algorithm of joint rotation to ensure the free manipulation of the pose and avoid the impossible pose.
2. When moving the legs, they will wear the mold with other parts of the body and surrounding objects. We will add collision mechanism to avoid such piercing.
3. Increase blinking function.
The above 1 and 2 points reflect the most players, which is also a difficulty. Most of the game animations on the market are fixed in advance, so there will be no wearing of models. The posture of the game is freely played by the players, so it needs complex calculation to avoid direct body collision and unreasonable posture. But we will try our best to optimize it in the shortest time. In addition, there are many things that need to be improved, including increasing the plot, increasing the playing method and so on. Please give us a little time. Let's start with the most responsive problems.
Thank you very much for your support!
